{{Quote|We'll have to use your ship, Luke! The Empire confiscated mine!|Anduvil of Ogem|<ref name="TS" />}}
This '''starship''' was piloted by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on a mission for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Accompanying Luke were [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Skywalker landed the vessel on [[pad 583]]. While Luke was engaged in a secret meeting with a Rebel [[Natala Vanden|contact]], a gang known as the [[Freelies]] tricked C-3PO into allowing them access to the ship, kidnapping Leia and R2-D2. Skywalker and C-3PO were able to rescue them from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assault ordered by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|director]] [[Cronal|Blackhole]] and escape aboard this vessel.<ref name="GW" />

[[File:LukeSkywalkersStarship-TatooineSojourn.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Skywalker pilots the vessel to Tatooine.]]
Later, Skywalker utilized it in an uneventful reconnaissance mission, until [[Massassi One]] issued a [[Code Grave]] order to abandon it and divert to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to [[Mission to Tatooine (Luke Skywalker)|investigate]] an Imperial [[transport capsule]] that landed on the planet and was currently in [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] custody. After landing the vessel in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], Skywalker made contact with Rebel [[operative]] [[Anduvil]] of [[Ogem/Legends|Ogem]], and the pair, along with C-3PO and R2-D2, accomplished the mission. Anduvil's ship had been confiscated by the Empire, so she departed Tatooine with Luke and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] aboard Luke's ship, along with a captured Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]] brought as insurance that they would be able to leave the system.<ref name="TS" />
